question: Joseph Francois Dupleix was the Governor General of which of the following East India companies in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**French**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Joseph Francois Dupleix:-**

 
 
• **He was the Governor General of the French East India Company in India.**
 
• He served as the Governor General from 1742 to 1754.
 
• Dupleix was known for his ambitious plans to expand French influence in India and played a key role in the Carnatic Wars.
 
• Under his leadership, the French East India Company established a strong presence in India and competed with the British East India Company for dominance.
